title: The Best Way to Take Notes
author: Scott Young
description: The best way to take notes may be the method that uses the least technology. I'll explain why notes still matter and how to learn better with them. The post The Best Way to Take Notes appeared first on Scott H Young .
summary: Is there still a point to taking notes these days? When I was in school, the purpose of note-taking was obvious.
takeaways: Note-Taking and Cognitive Load One area I didn’t get a chance to dive into in the video essay was somewhat more “advanced” note-taking strategies, such as mind-maps, linking ideas together, analogies or rephrasing material as retrieval prompts.

Broadly speaking, there’s evidence in favor of handwriting over typing notes out—evidence that becomes stronger, in my opinion, when you add the likelihood of digital distractions that occurs in most real-world situations with digital notes.
But the basic truth seems to be that anything that causes you to really pay attention while you’re sitting in a lecture is going to improve your academic performance.
